one_liner: Licensed clinician who runs court-ordered domestic violence intervention groups and manages a caseload of offenders for DC's federal supervision agency.
fit_summary: This role requires a current independent clinical license (LICSW, LPC, LMFT or comparable) plus GS-11-level experience facilitating domestic violence or cognitive-behavioral interventions for high-risk offenders. Nothing on file suggests Daniel has either, and emergency-management consulting and policy knowledge do not substitute. Daniel should not apply unless Daniel already holds such a license and has that clinical experience.
eligibility: Open to the public, but also to federal transition and veteran hiring paths, so no federal status is needed.
A current, unrestricted independent practice license (LISW, LICSW, LPC, LMFT or comparable) is mandatory, and a copy must be uploaded or you lose consideration.

You need one year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-11: facilitating evidence-based DV or cognitive-behavioral interventions for high-risk offenders, managing complex DV cases with advanced risk assessments, and collaborating with interdisciplinary teams.
Basic entry requires a behavioral or social science degree (or 24 semester hours), or equivalent experience or a combination. Transcripts are required for any claimed education.
You must pass the USA Hire assessments at or above the cut score.
strategy: First confirm whether you hold a current independent clinical license. If you do not, skip this posting, because the license requirement is pass/fail.
If you are interested in CSOSA, look instead for non-clinical roles such as program analyst, community outreach, or public affairs. Your policy knowledge and public-facing skills fit those better.
If you do qualify, mirror the specialized experience language on your two-page resume. List dates, hours per week, and specific DV or CBT group facilitation and risk-assessment work.
Answer the questionnaire honestly. Overstating qualifications can remove you from consideration, and the license and transcripts will be checked.
Upload the license copy and transcripts before the November 13, 2026 closing date, and set aside uninterrupted time for the USA Hire assessments.
resume_bullets: Facilitated [number] weekly [DV/CBT curriculum] group sessions for [population] while maintaining fidelity to the intervention model; [hours/week].
Conducted [risk assessment tool] assessments for a caseload of [number] participants and recommended [intervention or supervision decisions] to [partners].
Coordinated with [probation officers/courts/victim advocates] to address [co-occurring issues] and improve program outcomes such as [result, if documented].
interview_questions: How do you respond when a participant minimizes or denies abusive behavior in group?
Walk us through how you prioritize victim safety when a participant misses sessions.
Describe a complex DV case where your risk assessment changed the supervision or intervention plan.
How do you maintain curriculum fidelity while adapting for participants with substance use or mental health issues?
watch_outs: The mandatory clinical license almost certainly disqualifies you based on your known background.
The specialized experience must be clinical DV or offender intervention work. Emergency-management consulting will not count.
Missing transcripts or a missing license copy results in automatic loss of consideration.
